messages:
maya: Quick sync — want to run a small PLG experiment next week. Goal: nudge new signups from signup -> first meaningful action (FMA) within 48h. Idea: give a tiny credit bump tied to an onboarding task + prebuilt prompt templates. Thoughts?
sam: love it. propose 2 arms: (A) micro-credit + checklist, (B) onboarding flow + templated prompts + no extra credits. measure conv to FMA and 7-day retention.
andre: add a third arm with 1-click "apply template" buttons in the UI; reduces friction.
priya: For messaging we should A/B header: "Try with 50 free credits" vs "Run your first prompt with 2 clicks". Make copy talk about cost predictability (low tokens) so they're not scared.
jordan: Metrics: FMA conversion, time-to-first-token, tokens used in first session, revenue conversion 14d. Add tracking: event `onboarding_template_applied` and `credit_bump_used`.
sam: timeline: quick dev changes + templated prompt pack + 1-week ramp. Can marketing own copy + webinar mini? We could schedule a 30-min 'first Prompt' live demo to accompany.
maya: Webinar idea: "From zero to useful in 15 minutes" — demo using prompt templates for common use cases (summarize, Q&A, codegen). Short CTA to claim credits.
priya: Landing copy draft: "Claim 50 credits and ship your first AI feature — in under 15 minutes." Also split test imagery: product UI vs outcome screenshots.
andre: Ops note: Dedicated routing — ensure trial traffic goes to hosted API region us-west-2 to avoid latency affecting dropoffs.
jordan: Also set up a small eval: benchmark narrative in the webinar comparing time-to-FMA vs competitor baseline. Use token cost example.
maya: OK. Owners: Sam (experiment infra), Priya (copy + landing), Andre (UI + routing), Jordan (tracking + metrics), Maya (webinar). Sam, can you estimate dev hours?
sam: 2 d for template infra + 1 d landing + 1 d event setup. Can ship in 6 business days if we prioritize.
priya: I'll draft 3 hero lines and 4 prompt templates by EOD Tue.
andre: I'll add the 1-click apply + routing flag behind a feature-flag. ETA Thu.
jordan: I'll add the analytics events + dashboard. Want to track cohort by landing_variant.
maya: Great — calendar invite after this. Launch plan: soft rollout to 10% of new signups, monitor FMA within 48h, ramp if +10% lift. :rocket:
launch-bot: experiment created: exp_id=exp_2026_credit_surge_001 — rollout 10%, metric=FMA_conversion_48h.
sam: noted. tagging growth and product channels. Anything else?
priya: Suggest social copy for webinar: "Ship your first AI feature — claim free credits and step-by-step templates." I'll drop drafts.
maya: Perfect. We'll reconvene Wed standup. Thanks :thumbsup:
